title: Lebanon Marks Sixth Anniversary of Beirut Port Blast Amid New Destruction
detail: Lebanon marked the sixth anniversary of the August 4, 2020 Beirut port explosion, which killed at least 218 people, with marches and vigils demanding justice. Families of victims continue to press for accountability; the case file was sealed in March 2026 and referred to the Court of Cassation for review, a step toward eventual trials. The anniversary was overshadowed by fresh destruction in south Lebanon from the ongoing Israeli campaign.

media.caption: Lebanon marks the sixth anniversary of the Beirut port explosion

title: Seventh Round of US-Brokered Israel-Lebanon Talks Begins in Rome
detail: Lebanese and Israeli delegations began a three-day, seventh round of US-sponsored negotiations in Rome, focused on implementing the June 26 framework agreement. Talks centered on expanding the pilot-zone process in southern Lebanon — starting with Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh, Srifa and Froun — under which the Lebanese Armed Forces verify Hezbollah's disarmament as Israel withdraws. The US ambassador warned that rushing the process risked the civilians it was meant to protect.

media.caption: Lebanese and Israeli delegations meet for a seventh round of talks in Rome
